## Brief
Phase 2 of the 0.13.4 release: build, verify and stage every artifact, then block before publishing. Everything happens in the BadTakes main checkout (/Users/ericlugo/Personal/BadTakes) on branch chore/release-0.13.4, where Spud has committed the bump and pushed tag v0.13.4. The tag started release.yml's Windows build.

Follow .claude/skills/cutting-a-release/SKILL.md and docs/RELEASING.md § 3 to § 6 in order. Every gate in the skill's Gates section must pass, and none is optional.

Do:
1. § 3 prep: `git worktree prune`, then the idle check from the skill (`pgrep -fl 'electron|node' | grep -E '\.claude/worktrees|\.worktrees'`). If a worktree process is running, block and name it; otherwise go. `rm -rf dist dist-arm64 dist-x64`, `npm ci`, then `npm run dist:signed` with run_in_background, since notarization takes tens of minutes. Read the whole log on a failure. For hdiutil busy or errSecInternalComponent, rerun with BT_MAC_SERIAL=1.
2. § 3.5, during the notary wait: `npm run dist:ios` (build only, NO `--upload`, NO `--validate`), never with BT_ADMOB_TESTING set. Check the archive's CFBundleShortVersionString is 0.13.4, CFBundleVersion is 13004, and the DistributionSummary entitlements include beta-reports-active. Then run the ATT proof from docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-14-ios-app-review-guest-mode-design.md § 3.2 on the exported .app inside the .ipa: nm, otool -L and plutil must find no AppTrackingTransparency, NSUserTracking, GADApplication or SKAdNetwork. Report the commands and their output.
3. § 4, after the build: verify:signing on every .app AND every .dmg; the asar leak check on every mac app.asar; the bundled fonts; the packaged-app smoke with a seeded library (`rm -rf /tmp/bt-lib && cp -R fixtures/library /tmp/bt-lib`, BT_LIBRARY_ROOT=/tmp/bt-lib, SMOKE_DIR set), which must print SMOKE_OK; the kit tarball check; the document types and UTI.
4. § 5: find the release.yml run for tag v0.13.4, wait for it to finish (poll `gh run view` at a sensible interval rather than every few seconds), and download its Windows artifacts as the runbook says. If it failed, block with the failing job and log excerpt.
5. § 6: stage into dist/release/ exactly as the runbook says, never the .ipa or anything under dist/ios/, and run check-release-assets.js with GITHUB_REF_NAME=v0.13.4.

Then run `member result` with every gate's command and outcome, the staged asset list, and the .ipa path and stamps. Then `member block` saying phase 2 is green and the release is ready for Eric's go-ahead on two separate things: (a) § 7, publishing to 0snug0/BadTakes-releases, binaries first and feeds second, with the body from docs/release-notes/0.13.4/body.md; (b) `npm run dist:ios -- --upload` to App Store Connect.

Never run `gh release create`, `gh release upload`, `npm run dist:ios -- --upload`, `--validate`, npm publish, or any git commit, push, tag or merge. Those wait for Eric's approval and for Spud. Do not use the Browser pane; another agent is driving App Store Connect in it.
